messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 在2015年，世界国际象棋锦标赛（World Chess Championship）冠军是马格努斯·卡尔森（Magnus Carlsen）。他以9½‑7½的总比分击败了对手谢尔盖·加里金（Sergey Karjakin），成功卫冕他的王者头衔。
message.reasoning:
The user asks about who won the 2015 International Chess Championship. They likely refer to the World Chess Championship 2015? That was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title successfully.

But maybe they mean something else like the 2015 ICCF or some other tournament. But typical question would be "Who won the 2015 international chess championship?" Usually it's Magnus Carlsen.

We can answer directly without using tool because no need to analyze board positions. So we respond with text.
